scope: Evidence review for new signals and changed recipes; existing frozen verdicts and operational authorizations are not rewritten.
selection_rule: Freeze candidates, horizons, mapping, training selection, fixed/dynamic timing and net comparison rules before results. Evaluation may falsify the fixed claim; choosing or tuning by evaluation makes it development data for the new decision.
decay_rule: Require an explicit, evidence-linked decay/stability assessment and uncertainty or an honest unidentifiable/not-applicable status. A null estimate is not infinity or healthy. Justify cadence with matched net portfolio and delay evidence; no universal minimum lifetime or IC threshold.
net_rule: Predeclare study-specific net Sharpe and return/drawdown guards, actual traded costs, fixed and dynamic controls, chronological stability, cash, buy-and-hold and simple matched controls. Treat FR25 as an empirical incumbent with asset/period dependence.
data_rule: Pinned published audited inputs and verified hashes; explicit price/activity basis, missing-data behavior, historical publication and membership limits. Audited revised histories do not become point-in-time certified.
authority_rule: Assessment is an evidence checklist, not scientific certification or permission. Monitoring, promotion, allocation and execution still require their existing independent application/operator controls.
retention_rule: Closed exploratory studies retain compact findings, protocol/runner and closure/retirement receipts. Classify generated bulk outputs for guarded maintenance; active, funded, pending, promotion, canonical and broker evidence remain protected.
